## About
DSD Automotive is a restoration and custom shop on N Kealy Ave in Lewisville, run by owners Dave and Stephen DuSold.
We work on cars and motorcycles, from maintenance and repairs to ground-up builds. That might be a frame-off restoration of a classic, a Pro-Touring build, or a one-off piece of fabrication for your project.
We like to start with a conversation. Tell us what you want the finished car to be, and we'll help you consult, design and build it.

## Services
- Restoration: Full restoration work on classics, up to frame-off builds.
- Custom paint and metal polishing: Paint and polishing work for show cars and personal rides.
- Fabrication: One-off parts and pieces made for your build.
- Paintless dent repair: Dent removal without repainting the panel.
- Design and planning: Help mapping out your next project before work begins.
- Maintenance and repairs: Ongoing care for your car or collection, alongside bigger builds.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on motorcycles?
A: Yes. We care for cars and motorcycles.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: How soon will I hear back if I use the contact form?
A: If a reply is needed, you'll hear back within 48 to 72 hours.
